ahj.name: the authority having jurisdiction

exercise-programme-doctrine.this_pack_reproduces: none of it - the debrief structures below are this pack's own scaffold and are not that doctrine

fema-nims.name: FEMA and the National Incident Management System
fema-nims.owns: the incident command structure, its position descriptions and the resource typing everything else refers to

fire-accrediting-bodies.this_pack_reproduces: none of it - no certificate, reciprocity claim or equivalency is asserted here

look_for: gives a description that a person who cannot see the building could act on
names what is NOT there as well as what is - no smoke showing is information
updates the picture out loud when it changes rather than quietly revising it
separates what is observed from what is assumed
competencies.title: Scene size-up and its transmission
competencies.what_it_is: Forming a picture of what is in front of you on arrival and saying it out loud so that everybody still driving towards it has the same picture.
competencies.why_it_matters: The first sixty seconds of description sets what every later crew expects to find, and a size-up nobody transmitted is a size-up only one person has.

look_for: announces command in terms that can be heard and logged
a transfer includes a face-to-face or explicit acknowledgement, not an assumption
the person relinquishing command can say what they handed over
nobody on the incident is unable to name who has command
competencies.title: Establishing, holding and transferring command
competencies.what_it_is: Declaring that command exists, holding it visibly, and passing it in a way that leaves no gap where nobody is in charge.
competencies.why_it_matters: Every multi-agency review of a bad incident finds the same gap: two people each thought the other had it, or a transfer happened on a radio channel one of them was not on.

look_for: can state where each member of their crew is without looking
does not separate without saying so and being acknowledged
responds to accountability checks promptly and accurately
flags a crew that has gone quiet rather than waiting
competencies.title: Crew integrity and personnel accountability
competencies.what_it_is: Staying a crew: knowing where your people are, being findable yourself, and being counted.
competencies.why_it_matters: A responder who is alone in a building nobody knows they are in is the precondition for most of the worst outcomes in this service.

look_for: reports air status without being asked for it
plans the way out at the same time as the way in
treats a crew member's consumption as the crew's problem
does not negotiate with an alarm
competencies.title: Treating breathing air as a managed resource
competencies.what_it_is: Holding, as a habit, the awareness that a finite consumable is being spent and that the exit takes as long as the entry did.
competencies.why_it_matters: This is a culture competency, not an arithmetic one. The actual management points and thresholds belong to the standard and the agency procedure and are not stated here.

look_for: can articulate what would make them declare, in advance
does not treat a declaration by somebody else as an overreaction
a crew that declares is debriefed on the decision, not on the noise
the training culture has actually rehearsed somebody declaring
competencies.title: Recognising trouble and declaring it early
competencies.what_it_is: Being able to recognise that you are the emergency now, and saying so before the situation has decided for you.
competencies.why_it_matters: The reluctance to declare is the documented failure mode - responders delay because declaring feels like a personal failure. The scaffold here is the psychological one; the message format and the response to it belong to the standard and the agency.

look_for: names the construction features they can actually see
identifies where a building has been altered rather than built
says what they do not know about the concealed spaces
connects a construction observation to a consequence out loud
competencies.title: Reading what a building is made of
competencies.what_it_is: Recognising construction type, era and alteration from the outside, and knowing that the answer changes what the building will do.
competencies.why_it_matters: This is the single competency that most directly connects this pack to the rest of the bundle: the 111 trade halls are the people who built, altered and maintained the thing the crew is standing in.

look_for: states what the position is FOR before taking it
leaves room for the units not yet on scene
reports the position in terms others can build on
can explain what the position gave up
competencies.title: Positioning as a decision that forecloses other decisions
competencies.what_it_is: Understanding that where the apparatus stops decides what it and everything behind it can do for the rest of the incident.
competencies.why_it_matters: A position is easy to take and expensive to change. The judgement is about what the next three arriving units will now be unable to do; the distances and the setup belong to the manufacturer and the agency.

look_for: identifies the supply before it is needed, not when it fails
tells command what the constraint is in time to change the plan
notices when another unit's draw is the explanation
reports a supply problem as a problem, not as an apology
competencies.title: Reasoning about supply as a constraint
competencies.what_it_is: Thinking about where the water is coming from, how long it lasts and who else is drawing on it, as a constraint on the plan rather than a plumbing detail.
competencies.why_it_matters: Supply failures are rarely dramatic; they are a plan that quietly could not be sustained. No flow, pressure or volume figure appears in this pack.

look_for: messages are addressed and acknowledged, both ways
priority traffic is recognisably different from routine traffic
the speaker stops when the message is complete
an unacknowledged transmission is repeated rather than assumed
competencies.title: Radio discipline and closed-loop communication
competencies.what_it_is: Brief, ordered, acknowledged traffic: who you are, who you want, what you need, and hearing it come back.
competencies.why_it_matters: The fireground is loud, the channel is shared, and an unacknowledged message is not a message. This is the competency that makes every other one transmissible.

look_for: states the benefit being sought, specifically
states what information the decision rests on and how old it is
revisits the decision when a report contradicts the assumption
is able to withdraw without treating it as a defeat
competencies.title: Risk and benefit as an explicit frame
competencies.what_it_is: Being able to say what is being risked, for what, and on what information - before committing, and again when the information changes.
competencies.why_it_matters: The frame is the profession's own and is stated in its standards and its culture. What this pack scaffolds is the habit of saying it out loud; what counts as acceptable risk is the agency's and the standard's to set.

look_for: delegates rather than absorbing every task
knows the state of each member, not just the task
gives an assignment the member can repeat back
notices a member who has stopped speaking
competencies.title: Supervising a company under load
competencies.what_it_is: Keeping a small team effective when the environment is hostile, the information is partial and the officer is also doing a task.
competencies.why_it_matters: The step from doing to supervising is the step most often taken with no training at all, and it is where crew integrity is either kept or lost.

look_for: separates what happened from who did it
the most junior person present says something
produces at least one thing that will actually change
records a disagreement as a disagreement rather than resolving it for the room
competencies.title: Running a debrief that people tell the truth in
competencies.what_it_is: Structuring a review so that what actually happened surfaces, including the parts that are embarrassing.
competencies.why_it_matters: A debrief that only produces agreement has produced nothing. This competency is the one that makes every other record in this pack correctable.

look_for: the habit is visible when nobody is watching
contaminated gear does not travel into clean space
a new member is corrected without ceremony
the officer models it rather than mandating it
competencies.title: Exposure reduction as an ordinary habit
competencies.what_it_is: Treating post-incident contamination as a routine hazard with routine handling, rather than as a special case.
competencies.why_it_matters: The long-run occupational disease burden in this service is the largest single threat to the people in it, and it is carried home on gear. The specific cleaning and monitoring requirements belong to the standard and the employer.

look_for: recognises the interface condition and says so
thinks about egress for civilians and for the crew as one question
hands off to the agency that owns the landscape fire rather than competing with it
can state what the weather is doing to the problem
competencies.title: Wildland-urban interface awareness
competencies.what_it_is: Recognising that a structure incident in an interface is also a landscape incident, with different time constants and a different evacuation problem.
competencies.why_it_matters: The interface is where this service, law enforcement, emergency management and social services all end up on the same road at the same time, and each has a different clock.

look_for: can state the basis for an action at the time, not only later
the written account matches the stated basis
stops when the basis stops
asks a supervisor rather than proceeding on an unclear basis
competencies.title: Knowing where the authority comes from and where it stops
competencies.what_it_is: Being able to articulate the source and the limit of the authority being exercised, in the moment and afterwards in writing.
competencies.why_it_matters: Authority that cannot be articulated is authority that will not survive review, and the person it was exercised on already knew that.

look_for: creates time rather than consuming it
the words used would read the same way in a transcript
asks rather than commands where asking is available
can say afterwards what they were trying to achieve with each step
competencies.title: De-escalation as communication, and time as a resource
competencies.what_it_is: Using distance, time, cover and language to reduce the pressure on a decision rather than to accelerate it.
competencies.why_it_matters: Most of what this competency is about is deciding not to close the distance yet. The tactics are the agency's and the POST commission's; the scaffold here is the disposition.

look_for: names what they observed rather than what they concluded
requests the co-response or clinical resource early
can describe the local pathway without looking it up
hands over with information rather than with a label
competencies.title: Recognising a behavioural health crisis and getting the right people
competencies.what_it_is: Identifying that the call is a health call, and knowing the referral and co-response pathway rather than improvising a clinical judgement.
competencies.why_it_matters: This is the hinge between this service and the social work service, and the competency is explicitly NOT to assess or diagnose - it is to recognise and hand over.

look_for: the account is specific enough to be disagreed with
the account is written before the officer has seen the video, where the agency requires that
a supervisor's review adds something rather than initialling
a pattern across reports is treated as a finding
competencies.title: Reporting and reviewing force, as an accountability practice
competencies.what_it_is: Documenting what was done and why in a way that a reviewer, a court and the public can follow. This pack carries nothing about technique.
competencies.why_it_matters: The review is where the profession either learns or does not. A report that is a template is a review that did not happen.

look_for: explains what is happening and why, unprompted
lets the person speak before the decision is announced
treats the outcome and the explanation as separate obligations
behaves the same way when not recorded
competencies.title: Procedural justice in ordinary encounters
competencies.what_it_is: Voice, neutrality, respect and explanation, in the encounters nobody will ever review, which is almost all of them.
competencies.why_it_matters: Legitimacy is built in the routine stop and spent in the crisis. The research base and the standard belong to others; the behaviours are observable here.

look_for: goes to the call rather than waiting for the report
gives a correction close to the event
can name which of their people is currently struggling
escalates rather than absorbing
competencies.title: First-line supervision as the first accountability layer
competencies.what_it_is: Being present at the calls that matter, reviewing what the squad produced, and intervening early rather than documenting late.
competencies.why_it_matters: The first-line supervisor is the only person positioned to stop a developing problem, and is usually the least trained for it.

look_for: records what is not known as not known
distinguishes observation from inference in the text
the evidence record is contemporaneous
a correction is made as a correction, not as an overwrite
competencies.title: Report writing and evidence integrity
competencies.what_it_is: Writing an account that is accurate, complete and honest about uncertainty, and handling evidence so that its history is intact.
competencies.why_it_matters: Everything downstream - charging, defence, review, the person's life - runs on this document and this chain.

look_for: can identify the decision point in their own account
accepts an audit of their own stop data without treating it as an accusation
interrupts a colleague's shortcut in the moment
the explanation given is behaviour-based and survives being written down
competencies.title: Impartial policing and bias awareness
competencies.what_it_is: Noticing the decision points where a judgement was made on something other than behaviour, and building the habit of checking.
competencies.why_it_matters: Named here as a domain with an authority rather than as a slogan; the curriculum content belongs to the POST commission and the agency.

look_for: identifies the incident commander and reports in
requests through the structure rather than around it
holds a perimeter as an assignment with a stated purpose
does not create a second command post
competencies.title: Knowing your role inside somebody else's incident
competencies.what_it_is: At a fire, a hazmat release or a disaster, the officer is usually supporting a structure they do not command, and the competency is knowing that and working inside it.
competencies.why_it_matters: The documented multi-agency failure is not hostility; it is two agencies each running their own incident on the same ground.

look_for: can name the support that exists without looking it up
has used it or can say honestly why not
raises it with a colleague rather than about a colleague
a supervisor's response to a disclosure is not a duty change by default
competencies.title: Wellness, peer support and the culture that permits it
competencies.what_it_is: Knowing what support exists, being willing to use it, and being willing to be the person who suggests it to somebody else.
competencies.why_it_matters: The access, the confidentiality and the limits of any programme are the employer's and the agreement's; the competency is the willingness.

look_for: can name the community relationships the agency actually has
brings community organizations into planning rather than into briefings
accepts a public account of a failure
measures something other than activity
competencies.title: Building and spending legitimacy deliberately
competencies.what_it_is: Treating the relationship with a community as an account that is paid into in ordinary times and drawn on in emergencies.
competencies.why_it_matters: In a disaster, whether an evacuation order is believed depends on work done years earlier by people who are not on the incident.

look_for: states scene safety status explicitly
reports what was observed, with times, not a diagnosis
does not delay the handover to finish the police task
stays reachable for the question that comes ten minutes later
competencies.title: Handover to the medical service
competencies.what_it_is: Getting the scene to the point where clinicians can work, and giving them what they need in the order they need it.
competencies.why_it_matters: The officer is very often the first person with a patient and the last person with the information about how they got that way. The clinical content belongs entirely to EMS and the medical director.

look_for: pauses at the threshold rather than at the patient
states the hazard out loud to the partner
reassesses when the scene composition changes
withdraws and says why, rather than continuing and hoping
competencies.title: Scene safety and situational assessment
competencies.what_it_is: Reading the environment before and while working in it, and treating it as a thing that changes.
competencies.why_it_matters: The clinician who is injured has converted one patient into two and removed the person who was going to treat the first.

look_for: the same structure is visible on a simple call and a complex one
findings are stated as findings, in order
a reassessment actually happens and is recorded
the partner can follow the assessment without being told it
competencies.title: Working to an assessment framework rather than to a hunch
competencies.what_it_is: Following a consistent structure so that the same information is gathered every time, including on the calls that look obvious.
competencies.why_it_matters: The framework is the authority's. This pack records that a framework exists, that consistency is the point, and that no finding, threshold or cut-off appears anywhere in this pack.

look_for: can state the limit without hedging
asks for the higher level early rather than late
does not let a bystander's expectation move the limit
reports having reached the limit as information, not as failure
competencies.title: Knowing the edge of your own certification
competencies.what_it_is: Being able to say what your level may do here, in this state, for this agency - and what it may not.
competencies.why_it_matters: The edge moves between states and between agencies. A clinician who is unsure of their own edge will either exceed it or stop short of it, and both are harms.

look_for: can name who their medical director is, as a role
contacts medical control when the situation is outside the standing order, rather than improvising
documents the contact and the instruction
raises a protocol that did not fit through the review route rather than working around it next time
competencies.title: Working under medical direction
competencies.what_it_is: Understanding that the protocol belongs to a named physician, that practice happens on their authority, and how to reach them.
competencies.why_it_matters: This is the fact that most distinguishes this service from the other four, and the reason this pack contains no clinical content at all.

look_for: gives a structured handover without reading the whole record aloud
stops for the receiving team's question
the written record supports the verbal one
the times in the record are real times
competencies.title: The verbal handover and the record behind it
competencies.what_it_is: Transferring a patient with the information the receiving team needs, in an order they can use, and writing a record that still makes sense a year later.
competencies.why_it_matters: The handover is the highest-density information transfer in the whole chain and the most frequently identified failure point in reviews.

look_for: treats a refusal as an assessment, not as an exit
documents what was explained and what was understood
involves medical control where the agency requires it
leaves a route back - the person knows how to change their mind
competencies.title: Consent, capacity and refusal
competencies.what_it_is: The legal and ethical frame around treating somebody who does not want to be treated, or who may not be able to decide.
competencies.why_it_matters: The highest-risk call in this service is frequently the one where nobody was transported. The determination itself belongs to the state and the medical director.

look_for: takes the assigned role and stays in it
does not begin individual care while holding a system role
reports counts upward in the form that was asked for
hands the role over explicitly when relieved
competencies.title: Role clarity in a mass casualty incident
competencies.what_it_is: Knowing which positional role you hold, doing that and not the other one, and accepting that the ordinary standard of care has been replaced by a system decision made above you.
competencies.why_it_matters: The triage system, its categories and every cut-off in it belong to the state EMS office and the medical director. This pack names the role discipline and stops.

look_for: the senior clinician invites the challenge explicitly
the junior clinician raises a concern and it changes something
roles are stated at the start of the call
a disagreement is resolved audibly and then recorded
competencies.title: Crew resource management in a two-person team
competencies.what_it_is: Two people, one of whom may be far more experienced, making decisions without the junior one going silent.
competencies.why_it_matters: The junior clinician who noticed something and said nothing is a recurring finding, and it is a team design problem rather than a character problem.

look_for: the habit does not degrade under time pressure
an exposure is reported the same day it happens
a new member is corrected immediately
the vehicle is treated as a clinical space
competencies.title: Infection and exposure control as routine
competencies.what_it_is: Standard precautions as an unremarkable habit, plus knowing what to do about an exposure afterwards.
competencies.why_it_matters: The reporting pathway, the prophylaxis and the timeframes belong to the employer and the health authority; the habit belongs here.

look_for: reaches for the reference or the resource rather than the analogy
adapts communication to the patient in front of them
involves a carer or interpreter as a source rather than a nuisance
says out loud when the call is outside their usual population
competencies.title: Recognising that populations differ, without pretending to the specifics
competencies.what_it_is: Holding the awareness that paediatric, geriatric, pregnant, disabled and non-communicating patients are not small or large versions of a default patient.
competencies.why_it_matters: Named as a domain with an owner. Every specific difference - anatomical, physiological, pharmacological - belongs to the authority and none is stated here.

look_for: establishes who is leading the interaction, early
reduces the number of people in the space
treats the medical assessment as still owed
the handover names what was tried, not only what happened
competencies.title: The behavioural emergency, and the other services in it
competencies.what_it_is: Working a call whose presenting problem is behavioural, alongside police and crisis clinicians, without defaulting to the tool nearest to hand.
competencies.why_it_matters: This is the four-way junction of this pack: the patient, the clinician, the officer and the social worker are all in the same small room with different obligations.

look_for: a supervisor takes a crew out of service and says why
the difficult call gets a check-in that is not a debrief
a pattern in one person is noticed by somebody other than them
the support offered is specific, not a poster
competencies.title: Fatigue, critical incident stress and the supervisor's part in it
competencies.what_it_is: Recognising the accumulation, having a route for the call that lands badly, and knowing that shift design is a clinical safety question.
competencies.why_it_matters: Duty hours and support access are bargained and employer-set; the competency is the supervisor noticing and acting.

look_for: can state their position and who they report to
requests through their supervisor rather than laterally
does not exercise authority their position does not carry
briefs their relief rather than simply leaving
competencies.title: Holding an ICS position and only that position
competencies.what_it_is: Taking a positional role, working inside its span, and handing it back cleanly - including when your day job is more senior than the role.
competencies.why_it_matters: The structure only works if rank outside it does not leak into it. The position descriptions and the doctrine belong to the national system; the discipline is the competency.

look_for: the common picture is maintained and is actually common
a request is tracked from arrival to resolution
the facility supports the incident rather than directing it
shift change does not lose the thread
competencies.title: Operating a coordination facility
competencies.what_it_is: Running the place where agencies that do not report to each other have to produce one picture and one set of priorities.
competencies.why_it_matters: An emergency operations centre coordinates; it does not command the incident. Confusing the two produces the second command post that every after-action report warns about.

look_for: asks before the need is acute
requests a capability in typed terms rather than by local name
plans for the receiving of it - feeding, housing, tasking
demobilises deliberately rather than by attrition
competencies.title: Requesting and receiving help from other jurisdictions
competencies.what_it_is: Knowing the mechanisms by which resources cross a jurisdictional line, and what obligations come attached.
competencies.why_it_matters: Asking late is the most common and most expensive error, and the second most common is asking for a capability in words the other jurisdiction does not use.

look_for: objectives are written so that somebody could tell if they were met
the plan covers a stated period and then is replaced
the planning meeting produces decisions rather than updates
the next period reflects the last one's results
competencies.title: The operational period planning cycle
competencies.what_it_is: The rhythm by which objectives are set, a plan is produced for a fixed period, and the next period starts from what actually happened.
competencies.why_it_matters: The cycle is the mechanism that stops an incident being managed by whoever spoke last. Its structure and forms belong to the national system.

look_for: one voice, and it is identifiable
the message says what to DO, not only what is happening
the message exists in the languages of the affected population
a correction is issued as visibly as the original
competencies.title: Public information and warning
competencies.what_it_is: Saying something true, actionable and timely to a public that may not trust you, in the languages they actually speak.
competencies.why_it_matters: A warning that is not believed is not a warning, and belief was decided before the event. Message content and alerting systems are governed elsewhere.

look_for: the voluntary organizations are in the planning, not only the response
shelter capability is described in terms of who it can actually take
reunification is treated as a named function with an owner
the count reported is a count somebody could reproduce
competencies.title: Mass care and sheltering coordination
competencies.what_it_is: Coordinating the feeding, sheltering and reunification effort, most of which is delivered by organizations that do not work for you.
competencies.why_it_matters: This is where government and the voluntary sector meet, and where the relationship either exists already or does not exist at all.

look_for: the method is stated before the data is collected
assessors record what they saw, not what they concluded about eligibility
safety of the assessors is somebody's explicit job
the trade expertise needed for a structural judgement is requested rather than improvised
competencies.title: Coordinating damage assessment
competencies.what_it_is: Getting a defensible picture of what is damaged, quickly enough to drive decisions and rigorously enough to survive audit.
competencies.why_it_matters: The assessment drives both immediate life safety and every later assistance programme, which are different questions asked of the same walk down the same street.

look_for: essential functions are named and prioritised in advance
succession is written down and the successors know
the plan has been exercised from a degraded starting state
staff whose own homes are affected are planned for
competencies.title: Continuity of operations for the responding jurisdiction
competencies.what_it_is: Keeping the jurisdiction's own essential functions running while it responds, including when its own buildings and staff are affected.
competencies.why_it_matters: The agency responding to the disaster is also in the disaster. This is routinely the plan that exists on paper and has never been walked.

look_for: a donations plan exists before it is needed
spontaneous volunteers are registered rather than turned away or turned loose
unsolicited goods have a stated destination
the ask to the public is specific
competencies.title: Volunteer and donations management
competencies.what_it_is: Handling the spontaneous arrival of people and goods, which is a certainty and is usually treated as a surprise.
competencies.why_it_matters: Unmanaged generosity consumes the response. Saying so out loud is not cynicism; it is the difference between help and a second logistics problem.

look_for: the plan names the populations rather than saying "vulnerable"
disability-led organizations were in the planning
transport-dependent populations have a stated mechanism
the shelter can actually receive the people the plan sends it
competencies.title: Access and functional needs inclusion
competencies.what_it_is: Planning so that disabled people, people without transport, people with limited English and people in institutions are in the plan rather than an exception to it.
competencies.why_it_matters: Every evacuation and sheltering failure that becomes a lawsuit becomes one here. The legal requirements belong to statute and are not stated in this pack.

look_for: the transition has a date, a structure and a named owner
the recovery structure includes people who were not in the response
unmet-needs work is a standing function rather than an appeal
the case-management handover to social services is explicit
competencies.title: Recovery and the transition out of response
competencies.what_it_is: Handing the problem from the responding structure to the long, unglamorous recovery structure without dropping it.
competencies.why_it_matters: Recovery lasts years, is where most of the money goes, and has almost none of the training attention. The transition is where communities get lost.

look_for: objectives are set before the scenario is written
the exercise is allowed to produce a failure
findings have an owner and a date
the next exercise starts from the last one's findings
competencies.title: Exercise design and turning findings into change
competencies.what_it_is: Designing an exercise that can fail, evaluating it honestly and producing improvements somebody is accountable for.
competencies.why_it_matters: An exercise designed to be passed has taught nothing and has consumed the day everybody had. The doctrine is federal; the honesty is local.

look_for: can name the boundary being pressured, in the moment
consults rather than deciding alone
dual relationships are surfaced rather than managed privately
documents the ethical reasoning, not only the action
competencies.title: Professional ethics and boundaries under disaster conditions
competencies.what_it_is: Holding the professional frame when the usual conditions - an office, a scheduled hour, a known caseload - have all gone.
competencies.why_it_matters: The code does not suspend in a disaster, and the situations that test it hardest are the ones where suspending it would feel kind.

look_for: offers choice where choice is available
explains before doing
does not require the story to be retold to each new person
notices when the setting itself is the problem
competencies.title: Trauma-informed practice as a default posture
competencies.what_it_is: Assuming that the person in front of you may have a history that makes the ordinary interaction costly, and designing the interaction accordingly.
competencies.why_it_matters: Applies to colleagues as well as clients, which is the part most often left out of the training.

look_for: slows the interaction rather than resolving it
the person's own words are used back to them
the number of people and the amount of noise is actively reduced
can say afterwards what the person actually asked for
competencies.title: Engagement and de-escalation in a crisis contact
competencies.what_it_is: Establishing enough connection, fast, that a person in acute distress will stay in the conversation.
competencies.why_it_matters: This is the competency that co-response exists to bring to a call. Clinical intervention beyond engagement belongs to the clinician's licence and to the state board.

look_for: uses the instrument the agency actually adopted, as intended
the referral is warm rather than a phone number
the loop is closed - somebody knows whether it landed
a refused referral is documented and revisited
competencies.title: Screening and referral pathways
competencies.what_it_is: Recognising the indicators that a referral is needed and knowing where the referral goes, in this jurisdiction, today.
competencies.why_it_matters: No screening tool, score, threshold or cut-off appears in this pack. Those belong to the instrument's owner, the state authority and the clinical supervisor.

look_for: can state that they are a reporter and under what law, in general terms
consults the agency route rather than deciding alone under pressure
tells the client what the limits of confidentiality are at the start
documents the decision either way
competencies.title: Mandated reporting literacy
competencies.what_it_is: Knowing that you are a mandated reporter, what that duty attaches to in your state and role, and what it does to the relationship.
competencies.why_it_matters: The duty is statutory, varies by state and role, and is one of the few things in this pack where a wrong summary could directly harm a child or an adult. No content is restated here.

look_for: the division of roles is agreed before the door, not at it
the clinician can call for the interaction to slow down and it does
the officer's safety role and the clinician's engagement role are both stated
the debrief includes both agencies in the same room
competencies.title: Role clarity in co-response
competencies.what_it_is: Working on a call alongside an armed officer or a medical crew with a clear, agreed division of who is leading what.
competencies.why_it_matters: Co-response fails in one of two directions: the clinician is a passenger, or the clinician is treated as having authority they do not have. Both are design failures.

look_for: a qualified interpreter is obtained rather than improvised
children are not used as interpreters
the worker asks rather than assuming the frame
materials exist in the languages of the population served
competencies.title: Cultural humility and language access
competencies.what_it_is: Working with people whose frame is not yours, and getting real interpretation rather than using a family member.
competencies.why_it_matters: In a disaster this becomes an operational question about who receives services at all, not a courtesy.

look_for: knows which record is under which rule
shares the minimum that answers the question asked
a request from another agency is answered against the rule rather than the relationship
the client is told what was shared where that is required
competencies.title: Documentation and confidentiality
competencies.what_it_is: Recording what is needed, sharing what is permitted, and knowing that the rules differ for behavioural health and substance use records.
competencies.why_it_matters: In multi-agency disaster work the pressure to share everything is constant and the consequences of over-sharing land on the client.

look_for: meets practical needs first and says so
does not require or invite disclosure
identifies who needs more than this and refers
works at the scale the situation actually has
competencies.title: Psychological first aid in a disaster setting
competencies.what_it_is: The immediate, non-clinical support offered to large numbers of people in the hours and days after an event.
competencies.why_it_matters: It is explicitly not therapy and explicitly not debriefing, and the distinction is the competency. The model belongs to its publishers and is not reproduced here.

look_for: supervision covers the worker as well as the case
caseload is treated as a safety variable and is actually adjusted
the supervisor models using support
a leaving worker is exit-interviewed honestly
competencies.title: Vicarious trauma and the supervision that catches it
competencies.what_it_is: Recognising the cumulative cost of the work in yourself and in the people you supervise, and building supervision that can hold it.
competencies.why_it_matters: Attrition in this workforce is a service continuity problem as much as a human one, and it is predictable.

look_for: the list is current because somebody checks it
eligibility barriers are named to the client in advance
the worker has contacted the resource rather than only listed it
gaps are reported upward as findings
competencies.title: Community resource navigation
competencies.what_it_is: Knowing what actually exists in this jurisdiction, whether it is open, and what it really takes to get in.
competencies.why_it_matters: The gap between the resource list and the resource is where most of the harm in this service happens, and it is invisible from a desk.

look_for: behavioural health is a named function in the plan, with a position
the function is activated at the same time as the others
the staffing plan covers weeks, not the first forty-eight hours
responder support and public support are planned as separate workloads
competencies.title: Integrating behavioural health into the emergency structure
competencies.what_it_is: Getting behavioural health a seat in the planning and in the incident structure rather than an appearance at the shelter after the press leaves.
competencies.why_it_matters: It is nearly always the last function integrated and the one with the longest tail; the structure it has to integrate into is the national incident management system's.

debrief_structure.purpose: Establish an agreed sequence before anybody explains anything. Disagreements about the sequence are recorded as disagreements.
debrief_structure.question: What actually happened, in order

debrief_structure.purpose: The gap between two people's pictures at the same moment is the finding. This is the question that most often produces one.
debrief_structure.question: What did each person think was going on at the time

debrief_structure.purpose: Attach each decision to the information available then, not to the information available now.
debrief_structure.question: Which decisions were made, by whom, on what information

debrief_structure.purpose: Time, hierarchy, an audience, a family member, a radio that would not clear. Pressure is a cause, not an excuse, and it is usually designable.
debrief_structure.question: What pressure was acting on the decision

debrief_structure.purpose: Tie the discussion back to the observable behaviours on the competency records so that the debrief produces something comparable across sessions.
debrief_structure.question: Which of the named competencies were exercised, and what was observed

debrief_structure.purpose: The moment a debrief starts arguing about the correct procedure, it has left this pack's scope. Name the body, go and read the actual standard, and bring it back.
debrief_structure.question: Which real standard or protocol governs the part we are now arguing about

debrief_structure.purpose: A debrief with no owner and no date has produced agreement rather than change.
debrief_structure.question: What will be different, who owns it, by when

debrief_structure.purpose: Held separately and last, and it is not a clinical intervention. The route belongs to the employer and to the behavioural health authority.
debrief_structure.question: Who needs something after this, and what is the route

honesty.coverage_is_published_as_a_number: Nothing here is described as comprehensive. 62 competency domains across 5 services, 25 scenario frames, 52 of 62 competencies exercised by at least one frame, 81 halls touched of 111. The gaps block carries 10 numbers and the closed ones stay listed.
honesty.nobody_qualified_has_read_this: Nothing in this pack has been reviewed by a serving firefighter, a police officer, a paramedic, an emergency manager or a licensed social worker. Not one of the 117 training items carries a sign-off - the number is 0 of 117 - and it must not be used as the basis of any real certification, qualification, hiring decision or operational procedure.
honesty.ppe_is_not_transferable: Each cross-linked hall publishes the PPE its own practice rooms require, read from surfaces/registry/finishes.json. That is the TRADE's protective equipment for a teaching space. It is not responder PPE, it is not an entry decision and it does not transfer. It is carried so that a frame about a collapse can show what the people who built the thing already wear, not so anybody can dress for an incident from it.
honesty.scaffold_not_protocol: This is a scaffold: role taxonomy, competency domains, scenario frames and debrief structures. It is not a protocol and contains no procedure, no drug, no dose, no triage cut-off, no vital-sign threshold, no tactical technique and no flow, pressure or air figure. 8 patterns for exactly those things are scanned over the finished registry and the build fails on any of them. Where a reader wants the real requirement, every one of the 117 items names the body that owns it.
honesty.status: AUTHORED: every word of this pack was written here. No standards document was opened, no page was fetched and no model produced any of it. This environment has no network - NFPA, NREMT, FEMA, the state POST commissions and the social work boards are all unreachable from it - so all 23 authority records carry document_read_by_this_build false and none carries a URL. A citation nobody opened is a costume.
honesty.the_authority_is_elsewhere: Each of the 23 authority records names a real body and states that this pack reproduces none of its content. NFPA owns the fire service qualification standards; the state POST commission owns law enforcement certification; NREMT and the state EMS office own the certification levels and the agency medical director owns every clinical decision under them; FEMA and the national incident management system own the command structure; the NASW code of ethics and the state licensing board own social work practice. This pack points; it does not restate.
honesty.the_cross_links_are_real: The 81 trade halls a scenario frame touches are resolved against pack/registry/halls.json at build time and an unresolvable slug stops the build, so no link here is invented. 30 of the 111 halls are touched by no frame at all and are listed by name. 2 frames touch no trade hall - a crisis call in a flat and the days after a line-of-duty death are not building problems, and pretending otherwise to improve a coverage number would be the dishonest option.
honesty.the_debrief_structure_is_ours: The 8-stage debrief structure below is this pack's own scaffold. It is not the federal exercise and evaluation doctrine, and it is not a critical incident stress intervention - the first belongs to FEMA, the second is a clinical activity belonging to licensed people, and confusing either with this would be a real harm.
honesty.unions_and_associations: IAFF, FOP, NAGE, AFSCME, SEIU, NASW and the other bodies named across the 5 services are real organizations. They are named here as TYPES of organization and by the role they play in a workforce. No local, lodge, chapter, council or bargaining unit number appears anywhere in this pack, no officer or member is named, and none of these organizations has reviewed, approved or endorsed any part of this - the endorsement count is 0 of 5 services.
honesty.what_a_frame_is: A scenario frame records a situation, the decision pressure it creates, the competencies it exercises and the questions a debrief would ask. It records no correct answer, and that is deliberate: the correct answer belongs to the governing authority and the local agency, and this pack holds neither. All 25 frames also state, in their own words, what they are NOT.
